role: PlanetryCore: persistent game levels, 100 game XP per level, configurable rewards, XP-bar display, PlaceholderAPI placeholders and durable network mail.
platform: Paper/Purpur backend plugin, not Velocity, Spigot or Folia.
compatibility: Paper/Purpur 26.1.2, Java 25, compiled against paper-api 26.1.2.build.74-stable. Local file storage is single-server only. Shared network progress uses MariaDB 10.11+ or PostgreSQL 14+ with the same database/table-prefix and authenticated forwarded UUIDs on every backend. Storage engines are not automatically migrated.
integration: Optional PlaceholderAPI 2.12.3 provides %planetry_level% and %planetry_gamexp% from an asynchronous refreshed cache; unloaded/unavailable data returns empty. Positive money rewards require Vault plus a registered economy provider; otherwise they remain queued. Console commands and money execute once per newly earned highest level; setlevel grants no rewards. XP display uses sendExperienceChange without rewriting Inventory Sync snapshots. Game XP replaces vanilla progression by default: XP pickups, advancement XP and death losses are suppressed, mending and survival XP-cost enchanting/anvil actions are blocked; vanilla-experience.lock=false opts back into vanilla gameplay. Rewards wait for an online living player. If NetworkInventorySync is installed, overlay and rewards wait for its main-thread isReady(UUID); installed but disabled/incompatible integrations refuse both. Quest/skill plugins award XP through console gamexp give. Network Chat can resolve backend placeholders through its existing optional PAPIProxyBridge integration. Network mail shares the same SQL configuration and forwarded UUIDs. /mail is public; planetry.admin.sendmail gates player/all sends and review, with console-only acknowledgement. All targets a snapshot of online Core sessions (5s heartbeat, 30s expiry); offline names are remembered on join or UUIDs can be used. Mail commands run as console on the claiming backend only after a durable non-retrying claim and Inventory Sync readiness. Rank snapshots use configurable PAPI placeholders, Vault chat or a Staff fallback; non-player senders are PLANETRY.
validation: Java25 mvn -B -ntp clean verify dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=target/test-classpath.txt. Both real database test suites require CORE_TEST_POSTGRES_URL/USER/PASSWORD and CORE_TEST_MARIADB_URL/USER/PASSWORD pointing to disposable databases. python3 scripts/smoke.py target/planetry-core-VERSION.jar runs pinned Paper26.1.2 with actual PlaceholderAPI and controlled player/economy/readiness fixtures; repeat with CORE_TEST_TYPE=postgresql and mariadb plus CORE_TEST_HOST/PORT/DATABASE/USER/PASSWORD. Validate real clients, Purpur, actual economy/quest plugins and network transfers on staging; never use production. See docs/ACCEPTANCE.md. Mail persistence/concurrency/recovery tests run for file and both SQL engines. Add --mail to smoke.py for mail command and notification probes, including --mail --without-hooks; CI runs mail probes in all storage modes. Real-client rank display, inventory capacity and cross-backend mail transfers require staging.
